ps.title: Planning settings
ps.sitesFailed: Couldn't load the sites you plan at

noAccess.title: Your role may not see the planning settings
noAccess.body: Your role does not include “planning.view”. Ask an administrator if you need this page.

noSites.title: No site to plan yet
noSites.body: Planning settings are kept per site. Add a plant in Admin › Companies & sites, or ask for the planning rights over one.

held.calendars: Keeping calendars needs the Calendars right (calendars.manage).
held.items: Keeping item parameters needs the item planning right (planning.items.manage).
held.settings: Keeping the planning settings needs the planning settings right (planning.settings.manage).

problem.read: The factory did not answer as expected. Try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not read this part for this site.
problem.offline: The factory cannot be reached: check the connection, then try again.
problem.gone: It is not there any more: someone removed or archived it.
problem.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again to go on.
problem.write: The change was not saved: the factory refused it.
problem.conflict: Someone else changed it meanwhile: read it again, then make your change.
problem.writeForbidden: Your role may not change this for this site.
problem.invalid: The change was refused as it is: check the value.
problem.unknown: No answer came back: the change may or may not be saved. Read it again to see.

noAccess.title: Your role may not see the calendars

elsewhere.title: Someone else changed the calendars
elsewhere.body: A calendar or a shift pattern of this company changed on another screen. Reload to see it; nothing of yours is lost.

readOnly.title: You can look, not change
readOnly.body: Keeping calendars needs the Calendars right (calendars.manage). Days still open to show what they are.

none.title: No calendar yet
none.body: {name} and the calendars above it have none: the site default (Monday to Friday, one shift 08:00–17:00) is used until you set one.

follows.title: {name} follows the calendars above
follows.body: Its days come from {above}. A change here makes its own calendar, which then keeps its own week and days.

cal.recalculatesNone: Recalculates capacity at once (no line or workshop on this site yet).

chain.ownAbove_one: Its own calendar · {count} dated day · above it: {above}
chain.ownAbove_other: Its own calendar · {count} dated days · above it: {above}

week.title: Working week and shifts
week.makeOwnHint: Its own calendar starts with the week above it; then its days, week and shifts are its own.

held.none: A calendar works at least one weekday.

follow.title: Follow the calendars above again — {name}?
follow.body_one: {name} stops using its own calendar; its {count} dated day is kept in its history. Its days then come from the calendars above.
follow.body_other: {name} stops using its own calendar; its {count} dated days are kept in its history. Its days then come from the calendars above.

day.title: {date} — {name}
day.decidedBy: Set by {by}. A change here is for {name} only.
day.noShifts: A working day the shift pattern has no shift on: it counts no working time. Pick a pattern with shifts on this weekday.

noPattern.extra: No pattern has more working time on this weekday: make one in Shift patterns below.
noPattern.short: No pattern has less working time on this weekday: make one in Shift patterns below.

day.name: Name (the reason)
day.makesOwn: Saving gives {name} its own calendar first.

held.pattern: Pick the shifts of the day first.
held.name: Give the day a name first (the reason).

closure.title: Add a closure
closure.reasonHint: Said on every day of the closure and on the plant calendar.
closure.impactIdle: Pick the days and where: the lanes and the work orders booked on those days are shown here.
closure.impactFailed: The booked work could not be read now; the closure can still be added.
closure.laneBooked_one: {count} work order booked · {minutes} min on those days
closure.laneBooked_other: {count} work orders booked · {minutes} min on those days
closure.otherSiteLanes: every line and workshop of that site
closure.impactNone: No line or workshop is reached.
closure.toBoard: Move the booked work on the planning board
closure.recalculates: Recalculates capacity at once, for every lane it reaches.

taken.title_one: {count} day is already set on a calendar
taken.title_other: {count} days are already set on a calendar
taken.keep: Keep those days as they are; close the other days

held.dates: Pick the first and the last day.
held.order: The last day is before the first.
held.long: A closure is at most 366 days.
held.taken: Say what happens to the days already set.

patterns.title: Shift patterns
patterns.hint: One shift, two shifts, Saturday morning: a calendar uses one; an extra shift or a short day picks one for a day.

empty.title: No shift pattern yet
empty.body: Without one, calendars use the planning default: 08:00–17:00 with a lunch hour, Monday to Friday.

held.inUse_one: Used by {count} calendar: give it another pattern first.
held.inUse_other: Used by {count} calendars: give them another pattern first.

pattern.name: Name
pattern.everyCompany: For every company of the group (else this company only)
pattern.inUse_one: Used by {count} calendar: a change recalculates its capacity at once.
pattern.inUse_other: Used by {count} calendars: a change recalculates their capacity at once.
pattern.label: Name (row {n})
pattern.nextDay: Ends the next morning (a night shift).

problem.code: Use 1 to 20 capital letters, digits or hyphens.
problem.name: Give the pattern a name.
problem.noShift: A pattern has at least one shift.
problem.overlap: Two shifts overlap on a weekday: working time would count twice.
problem.segment: This shift or break does not fit: check its times (a break inside its shift).

keys.title: Keys of the calendar
keys.open: Enter or a click — open a day: its exception
keys.range: Shift + arrows, then Enter — or a drag across days — select days for a closure
keys.month: Arrows — move by day and week; Page Up / Page Down — by month
keys.escape: Escape — let the selection go, close a dialog
keys.new: c — a new shift pattern (in Shift patterns)

problem.wholeCompany: The company's calendar and its patterns reach every site: keeping them needs Calendars (calendars.manage) over every site of the company.

notice.daySaved: Saved. Capacity recalculated at once for: {lanes}.
notice.dayRemoved: The day follows the week again. Capacity recalculated at once for: {lanes}.
notice.closureAdded: Closure added to {where}. Capacity recalculated at once for: {lanes}.
notice.closurePartly_one: Closure added to {done}; {count} calendar refused it: {refused}.
notice.closurePartly_other: Closure added to {done}; {count} calendars refused it: {refused}.
notice.weekSaved: Week and shifts saved. Capacity recalculated at once for: {lanes}.
notice.patternSaved: Pattern {code} saved. Calendars that use it recalculate their capacity at once.

print.title: Plant calendar {year} — {site}
print.held: Wait for the calendar to load.
print.daysNone: No day differs from the week this year.
print.lanesNone: Every line and workshop follows the site's days.
